market.summary: University networks and the national/public-library system are distinct integration opportunities. INE 2024 monthly-survey statistics list 141 libraries, including 28 in Maputo City and 19 each in Sofala and Tete; survey coverage is not an exhaustive LMS census. Major priorities retain large institutions even without a reachable public OPAC. Koha is the best evidenced reusable family in this discovery sample; the UEM official route is iAH/ISIS. No national LMS market-share estimate is supported.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritize Koha adapter validation at verified UJC and reserve ISUTC; BNM/UNISCED remain promising unverified origins, and UCM needs actual public endpoints. Add a separate iAH/WWWISIS connector for verified UEM. Zambeze has a real public JSON catalog, but its DIGITAL support flag and absent copy locations require interpretation before physical-availability use. No national LMS market share is implied.
